apply_command: cd backend && DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL alembic upgrade head
rollback_command: cd backend && DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL alembic downgrade k9l0m1n2o3p4
pre_apply_checks: Check no active transactions on target tables
post_apply_checks: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('mvp_invite','chat_feedback','mvp_analytics_event')
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='app_users' AND column_name='is_admin'
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='mvp_invite' AND column_name='code_hash'
